# Requirements Quality Checklist: 001-product-price-filter

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the price filter (validation / API and UI / URL state) before plan and tasks are approved
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are accessibility requirements defined for the two price inputs and their messages (label association, how a message is announced / linked to its input)? [Gap, Spec §PROD-001 UI, Spec §PROD-003 UI]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the layout of the two new inputs on narrow screens (≤ 400 px, NFR-040) specified, or deliberately left to a stated default? [Gap, Spec §PROD-001 UI]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define when a check message disappears (on the next edit of the input, on the next valid "Search", or when the URL changes)? [Gap, Spec §PROD-003 UI]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior defined when the visitor deletes the last product of a filtered page (today the list steps back one page) — is the range kept? [Gap, Spec §PROD-002 URL state]
- [ ] CHK005 Are logging / observability needs for rejected price requests (HTTP 400) stated, or explicitly not required? [Gap, NFR]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "the existing loading state" for a new range unambiguous, given that the list today keeps the previous page visible while the next one loads? [Ambiguity, Spec §PROD-002 Loading and errors]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified whether the URL keeps a valid bound as typed after trimming ("010", "10.50") or normalised, and whether two spellings of the same value give the same result? [Clarity, Spec §PROD-001 UI, Spec §PROD-003 Checks]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it clear that trimming of leading / trailing spaces applies to direct server requests too, not only to the UI inputs? [Clarity, Spec §PROD-003 Checks, Spec §PROD-003 Server]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "-0" (a minus sign followed by zero) classified unambiguously — rejected by check 1 or accepted as 0? [Ambiguity, Spec §PROD-003 Checks]
- [ ] CHK010 When the server returns several messages at once (both bounds invalid on a direct request), is it defined what the UI shows under "Giá tối thiểu ($)"? [Ambiguity, Spec §PROD-003 UI]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "responds in < 1 second" defined precisely enough to measure (one request or a percentile, cold or warm cache, on which machine)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, NFR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Is showing a server message for the maximum bound under "Giá tối thiểu ($)" consistent with the UI rule that each message appears under the input that failed? [Consistency, Spec §PROD-003 UI]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the five messages, their order and the "first failure wins" rule stated identically for the UI and the server, with no second copy that could drift? [Consistency, Spec §PROD-003 Checks]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the rule "invalid URL values are ignored" consistent with "the inputs show the range currently applied in the URL" and with PROD-002-S4? [Consistency, Spec §PROD-001 UI, Spec §PROD-002 URL state]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the new common empty-result description align with every place that describes the empty state (Context, PROD-002, Edge Cases table)? [Consistency, Spec §Overview, Spec §PROD-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the language rules consistent: new Vietnamese labels and messages next to the existing English "Search" button (NFR-040)? [Consistency, NFR-040]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Are the "sample ranges" of SC-002 and the "manual filter of the seed data" defined well enough for two reviewers to reach the same count? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-004 (works in Chrome, Safari, Firefox) be judged objectively — is a list of scenarios to check per browser stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Does every scenario's Then state exact observable values (products, URL, verbatim message, status) rather than "works" / "is shown correctly"? [Measurability, Spec §Requirements]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery requirements stated for every error scenario at P1–P2 (what the visitor does next, whether typed values are kept, whether a retry is safe)? [Coverage, Spec §PROD-002, Spec §PROD-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a valid bound with leading zeros ("010") or a trailing zero decimal ("10.50") covered by a scenario? [Coverage, Spec §PROD-003 Checks]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the interaction between a pending delete with undo (5-second wait) and an applied price range covered, or explicitly out of scope? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a product whose price changes to or from a bound while a filtered list is shown (beyond the cached-list case of PROD-001-S10)? [Coverage, Spec §PROD-001]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Is abuse of the public endpoint (many distinct ranges filling the Redis list cache, request rate) addressed, or explicitly accepted as out of scope? [Gap, NFR-001, NFR-011]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the known exception to constitution Principle II (no login, NFR-011) recorded with who approved it and when? [Traceability, Spec §PROD-001 Permissions, NFR-011]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the dependency on `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (without it the frontend calls dummyjson, which ignores `minPrice` / `maxPrice`) stated where a reader of the requirements would see it? [Dependency, Plan §Quickstart]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the brownfield assumption "search, sort and pagination keep their current behavior" bounded — is every current behavior PROD-002 relies on stated with its code source? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §PROD-002]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the two plan gaps (test files not type-checked, rendering scenarios only in a hand-run e2e) accepted explicitly by the reviewer rather than left implicit? [Assumption, Plan §Complexity Tracking, 001-ADR-5]

## Notes

- Reviewing this checklist: every decision added to the spec while resolving an item (a rule in the details, a
  Clarifications answer) comes with a scenario — a new `PROD-NNN-S<n>`, its row in `## Edge Cases & Error Handling`
  and in Traceability — or names the existing scenario that already tests it. A decision without a scenario has no
  test (`.claude/CLAUDE.md`, step 6).
- Spec changes found here go back through `/speckit-clarify` (and `/spec-edge-cases` for new scenarios); the plan
  never edits the spec outside Architecture Decisions and Data Model.
